unverifiable_exemptions: Leases, rentals, occupancies or tenancies of 100 days or less in duration for a vacation or recreational purpose
coverage.summary: Residential leases and tenancies at will statewide, except vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.
coverage.other_conditions: Does not apply to a lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of 100 days or less for a vacation or recreational purpose.

evidence.quoted_span: Any lessor of residential real property, or his agent, who accepts a security deposit from a tenant or prospective tenant

The lessor shall, within thirty days after the termination of occupancy under a tenancy-at-will or the end of the tenancy as specified in a valid written lease agreement, return to the tenant the security deposit or any balance thereof
No lease relating to residential real property shall contain a provision
The provisions of this section shall not apply to any lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of one hundred days or less in duration which lease or rental is for a vacation or recreational purpose.

result.notes: Coverage is otherwise correct. I set requires_unknown_facts to false because the law covers ordinary residential rentals statewide. I also listed the vacation/recreational short-term exemption under unverifiable_exemptions, because assessor data cannot identify a tenancy's purpose or duration. The statute has no unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy or landlord-size limits.
